task: Move the working proof-or-stop-graph package into this monorepo as packages/graph and expose it as the top-level CLI command proof-or-stop graph, without changing its behavior.
outcome: Running proof-or-stop graph inside this repository prints story and relation counts and a localhost URL, and that page serves the full interactive graph (d3 view, FTS5 search, story drawer, mermaid phase-flow, timeline playback) while leaving the inspected worktree clean.
facts: The source package at ~/work/repo/proof-or-stop-graph is @proof-or-stop/graph 0.1.0, 32 commits, HEAD 10b5921, with no git remote configured.

Its src/index.ts is an explicit library surface exporting createApp, startServer, findRoot, buildGraph, storyDetail, buildIndex/openIndex/search and the store helpers, so the CLI shell holds no logic.

Its tsconfig.json matches packages/main and packages/utils on every setting that matters: target ES2022, module Node16, moduleResolution Node16, strict, rootDir src, outDir dist, declaration, declarationMap, sourceMap, resolveJsonModule, esModuleInterop, skipLibCheck, forceConsistentCasingInFileNames.

This repository declares NO npm workspaces: the root package.json has no workspaces field, and there is no node_modules/@proof-or-stop or node_modules/@lattice link tree. Cross-package builds run as explicit npm --prefix <pkg> invocations chained in the root build script.
The root build script is: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/utils run build && node scripts/verify-full-suite-build-binding.mjs.

packages/utils declares a dependency on the unpublished @proof-or-stop/core@0.3.65 and has no node_modules in either the main checkout or a fresh worktree; npm install --prefix packages/utils fails with E404. Its tsc still passes because no file under packages/utils/src imports that package. This is a pre-existing stale manifest entry, not caused by or in scope for this story.

Registering a top-level command touches eight fail-closed surfaces: MAIN_TOOLS in packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts, a COMMAND_POLICIES row in packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts, a handler factory under packages/main/src/handlers, a registerBatch call in packages/main/src/registry.ts, the text-only process-fact mirror comment in packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts lines 194-440, DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS in packages/main/src/core/config.ts, READ_ONLY_COMMANDS in packages/main/src/cli/activity-policy.ts, and KNOWN_GROUP plus KNOWN_ORDER in packages/main/src/cli/help-renderer.ts.

command-ownership-contract.ts asserts every MAIN_TOOLS entry has a valid ownershipClass and a registered handler, and exempts exactly one command from the dispatchability assertion: STANDALONE_COMMANDS = new Set([dashboard]) at lines 90-95.
dashboard is dispatched from a dedicated pre-dispatch branch in cli-engine.ts near line 818 using a dynamic import, which is the precedent for a long-running server command.

The graph search index imports DatabaseSync from node:sqlite, which requires Node 22.5 or newer. node:sqlite is used nowhere else in this repository, and no package.json anywhere here declares an engines field.

packages/main ships zero static web assets: its serve dashboard is generated by inline template-literal functions in packages/main/src/verifier/serve.ts, it has no files field, and tsc does not copy non-TS files into dist.

The source repo gitignores assets/ with a comment stating that assets/app.html is assembled by scripts/build-web.mjs from src/shells/web/* and the vendor bundles are copied out of node_modules, so both are reproducible build output.

The graph index cache already lives outside the inspected repo, under the user cache directory keyed by a sha256 of the repo root, and builds to a pid-suffixed temp file atomically renamed into place.
Nothing in this repository references proof-or-stop-graph except one runtime log line under .lattice/runtime/host-runs/, so the documentation work is net-new rather than an edit of existing claims.
constraints: Pure migration confirmed by the user: no rewrite or redesign of the web shell, and no behavior change to graph rendering, search, or playback.
Vendored browser bundles and the assembled assets/app.html stay gitignored build output; they must not be committed.
The command must leave the inspected worktree byte-identical, because Proof-or-Stop gates DONE on a clean tree.
No npm publish and no git push: the story excludes registry publication, and this repo forbids remote pushes without an approved one-shot release approval.
The source repository must not be deleted or modified.
Every new tsconfig.json is picked up by the recursive tsc gate that validate --lint and .githooks/pre-push both run, so packages/graph must compile clean.
Since this repo has no npm workspaces, packages/graph must build via an explicit npm --prefix chain entry rather than a workspace reference.
